name: r2-ring-mma
author: solx-loop
description: E1/H16: a pipelined cp.async ring (separate B and A rings, 8 chunks of k=64 in flight each, padded 144 B rows for conflict-free ldmatrix) feeding mma.sync, with B as the m16 operand, should overlap the tensor work with the B stream and reach <= 7.5 us at M=17-64.
